about: Agent host falsifiers: each entry breaks one check (exact text, replaced once), and every named test must then FAIL. Run with falsify.py. expect: caught (all named tests fail), compile_error (the mutation must not build), survives (known survivor, by design). Files are relative to examples/agent-host. command: host (cargo test of the guest), e2e (run-e2e.sh: the guest in a test Runtime), or selftest (this runner's own named self-test case, for a change to falsify.py).

falsifiers.title: the skill budget guard is gone, so an over-budget skill is appended
a skill may carry a host path
a harness error that exits non-zero is counted as a failed test
tests: a named test that does not run is not a catch

falsifiers.title: a name no test answers to is counted as a failed test
tests: a named test that does not run is not a catch

falsifiers.title: an interrupted edit is not put back before the error propagates
a test that exits zero without running is counted as a pass

edits.old:
proof = named_outcome(result, name)
        if (proof == "failed" and result.code == 0) or (proof == "passed" and result.code != 0):
            proof = "not run"
        outcomes[name] = proof
edits.new:
proof = named_outcome(result, name)
        outcomes[name] = "passed" if result.code == 0 else proof

tests: a named test that does not run is not a catch

falsifiers.title: the restore sits with the edit, so an interrupt at its return leaks

edits.old:
except BaseException as error:
            # guard_mutation's finally puts the originals back, for a Ctrl-C
            # or SIGTERM just after a replacement too. This frame only adds
            # the disk-full reason.
edits.new:
except BaseException as error:
            self.restore()
            # guard_mutation's finally puts the originals back, for a Ctrl-C
            # or SIGTERM just after a replacement too. This frame only adds
            # the disk-full reason.

tests: an interrupt at the end of the edit is restored

falsifiers.title: a self-test non-zero exit is a failure without proof that the case ran
